 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. The New York Jets entered the weekend with three injury question marks at wide receiver in Garrett Wilson , Omar Cooper Jr. and Adonai Mitchell.
 Wilson missed last week's game with a concussion and turned in two limited practices and one full session before drawing a questionable tag on Friday, Nov. 13.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Mitchell and Cooper are also questionable to play.
 Cooper is dealing with an ankle injury that initially kept him limited on Wednesday and Thursday. But he turned in a full practice on Friday, as did Mitchell, who was a late-week addition to the injury report with a knee injury.
 MORE: Bold predictions for Week 10 of 2026 NFL season 
 Now, here's what we know about Mitchell, Wilson and Cooper for the Week 10 contest against the Buffalo Bills.
 Will Garrett Wilson, Omar Cooper play today?
 New York Jets wide receiver Omar Cooper Jr. (83) gains yards after catch during the first half against Tampa Bay Buccaneers at MetLife Stadium. Credit: Vincent Carchietta-Imagn Images via Reuters Connect (Reuters)
 All three of the Jets' wideouts are expected to be in action on Sunday despite their injuries, according to NFL Network's Ian Rapoport .
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement "Jets WR Garrett Wilson (concussion) cleared the NFL's concussion protocol and will play today," Rapoport wrote on Sunday morning. "Meanwhile, WR Omar Cooper Jr. (ankle) and [Adonai] Mitchell (knee) are both expected to go after being listed as questionable."
 The Jets and Bills will kick off at 1 p.m. ET (CBS, Paramount+), so make sure to verify the status of all three players when the inactives drop at 11:30 a.m. ET.
 Garrett Wilson start-or-sit advice
 New York Jets wide receiver Garrett Wilson (5) runs with the ball after a catch in the first quarter against the New England Patriots at Gillette Stadium. Credit: Bob DeChiara-Imagn via Reuters Connect (Reuters)
 Wilson had his best showing in a few weeks against the Las Vegas Raiders in Week 8 when he tallied six catches for 83 yards. Not great, but it was a step up from the six catches for 70 yards combined in his previous two games.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Entering Week 10, Wilson ranks as WR18 overall in fantasy points per game, according to Fantasy Pros , which makes him a borderline WR2 option in all formats.
 This matchup against the Bills presents a great opportunity for a big game for Wilson. Buffalo sports the fourth-worst pass defense in the NFL and is giving up the seventh-most fantasy points per game to wideouts this season, according to CBS Sports .
 MORE: Fantasy football wide receiver rankings for Week 10 
 Wilson will take over the top wideout role, likely limiting Mitchell, who exploded for a career-high 142 receiving yards and a touchdown on seven catches last week. Lock Wilson into lineups this week.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Verdict: Start 
 Omar Cooper Jr. start-or-sit advice
 New York Jets wide receiver Omar Cooper J.r (11) runs with the ball against the Tennessee Titans during the first quarter at Nissan Stadium. Credit: Steve Roberts-Imagn Images via Reuters Connect (Reuters)
 Since returning from injury in Week 6, the rookie has posted a pair of 100-yard games and two scores, which has him ranked at WR14 overall in fantasy points per game in that span.
 But he also has a bagel mixed in, and he failed to capitalize with Wilson sidelined last week. Cooper recorded eight catches for just 58 yards against the Kansas City Chiefs, but that's still decent flex production.
 The Bills are a matchup Cooper owners will love, as the Bills are permitting the seventh-most fantasy points per game to the position and own the fourth-worst pass defense in the NFL.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement MORE: Week 10 fantasy football trade targets 
 And, with the Jets likely to be chasing points, there should be more pass attempts from New York's offense, which means more opportunities for Cooper.
 He's a viable flex play in Week 10.
 Verdict: Start
